step.cmd: Fact-find with the client to obtain the missing information. Ask the client to provide the following details, if necessary:

ul.li: the payment start date;
the payment end date;
the weekly or daily amount
the first week amount
the last week amount (if known), or whether the payment is continuing
the type of WCB payment (temporary support or full and final settlement)

step.cmd: Determine if the client was reached during fact-finding:

ul.li: If yes, and the client provided the missing information, go to step 6.
If yes, but the client cannot provide the missing information, go to step 8.
If the client was not reached or did not reply to the N-10-00-00 letter, go to Unable to reach the client for missing information . Unable to reach the client for missing information

step.cmd: Determine if the WCB payments end before the tentative BPC:

ul.li: If no, go to step 7.
If yes, go to Workers’ compensation benefits (WCB) are not earnings . Workers’ compensation benefits (WCB) are not earnings

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Issue: Select Other .
Comments: Type “Workers’ compensation benefits information received from the client.”
Details: Document the fact-finding details according to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy
Select Save .
Go to Reviewing the workers’ compensation benefits WCB . Reviewing the workers’ compensation benefits WCB

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the Q-01-00-00 letter to the client with the following attributes:

ul.li: Info required-Re: Antedate/Medical or treatment outside/Mat-Par Direct Deposit/Family Caregiver/Text (2886)
Specify information required
This letter replaces or Footnote (2365)
Footnote

Text - Footnote (11745): Type “If you want to provide this information by telephone, contact [your first name] at [your telephone number], [your work hours (in the client’s time zone, if necessary], before [date the information is due].”

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC as follows:

ul.li:
Details: Select the appropriate option:
Type “Unable to reach the client by telephone. Q-01-00-00 letter has been sent.”
Type “The client is reached but cannot provide the missing information. The client is waiting for the decision on their request for workers’ compensation benefits. Q-01-00-00 letter has been sent.”
Select Draft .

step.cmd: Move the WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Pending reason: Select Other .
Comments: Type “Q-01-00-00 letter sent.”
Bring forward date: Enter today’s date + 10 business days.

step.cmd: If the client provides the missing information within the 10 business days, do the following:

ul.li: Validate the client’s identity . Validate the client’s identity
Explain the reason for your call.
Conduct fact-finding.
Go to Reviewing the workers’ compensation benefits (WCB) . Reviewing the workers’ compensation benefits (WCB)

step.cmd: When the WI moves to the current workload, if the client has not provided the missing information, do the following:

ul.li: Open the draft SROC and select Save .
Go to Unable to reach the client for missing information . Unable to reach the client for missing information
